DRAG / ARROWS TO ORBIT · SCROLL TO ZOOM · SPACE CHANGES SURFACE

The mathematics

A Klein bottle is a closed, non-orientable surface. Its familiar bottle shape is an immersion into three dimensions: the neck passes through the wall, while the abstract surface does not join at that crossing. Neck width changes the shape; Surface reveal opens a cutaway. Space cycles glass, solid, and wireframe views. The fully revealed mesh identifies its end with a reversed parameter direction. Local shading is two-sided because no consistent global normal exists.
